title: Ledgato Enforcement Permit
description: Issued by Ledgato only on ALLOW. Ed25519 signature by issuer_public_key over the canonical JSON of every field except signature. Single use: the protected resource burns permit_id before acting. Verified by engine/ledgato/enforcement.py::verify_permit.

contract_digest.description: SHA-256 of the canonical action contract.

ledger_entry_hash.description: Hash of the signed ledger entry that recorded the ALLOW.

issuer_public_key.description: Base64 Ed25519 key. Must be pinned by the resource.
